title: Ellopták! Asking the Police for Help

sections.title: Stolen or lost
sections.content: When something is stolen or lost, you ask the police (*rendőrség*, which you know) for help. *ellop* means "to steal". Hungarians usually say it without naming anyone: **Ellopták a táskámat!** ("They stole my bag!", i.e. My bag has been stolen!). For a loss use *elveszít*, which you know: **Elvesztettem a telefonomat.** (I've lost my phone.)

sections.title: At the police station
sections.content: At the police station you make a report, a *feljelentés*: **Feljelentést szeretnék tenni.** (I would like to report a crime.) A lost umbrella or glove is not a crime: ask at the lost property office, **Talált Tárgyak** (a fixed name, literally "found things").

items.english: My bag was stolen on the tram!
I've lost my phone. Could you help me?

items.spanish: Jó napot! Feljelentést szeretnék tenni, mert ellopták a táskámat.
items.english: Hello! I would like to report a crime, because my bag has been stolen.
